title: Understanding the Decision Threshold
text: The decision threshold in a logistic regression model determines the cutoff point for classifying an observation into one of two categories. By default, this threshold is often set at $$0.5$$.

title: Effect of Lowering the Threshold
text: Lowering the decision threshold means that the model will classify more observations as 'Kendrick' because it requires a lower probability to make that classification.

title: Impact on False Positives and False Negatives
text: Consider how lowering the threshold affects the number of false positives and false negatives. A lower threshold may increase false positives for 'Kendrick'.
